newsitem.title: FRANCE: Havas sees no big investment before end-98.
newsitem.headline: Havas sees no big investment before end-98.

text.p: French communication company Havas is unlikely to undertake major investments before the end of 1998, chairman Pierre Dauzier told a meeting of share analysts on Friday.
"I do not see 1997 and the first part of 1998 as a strong period for investment at Havas," he said.
"First we need to define our strategy with our partners, then at the end of 1998 move on the investments we will have considered carefully," he said.
He also said in reply to a question that Havas was unlikely to plough large sums of money into multimedia in the near future.
Talk of hefty investment "seems to me to be out of proportion to profitability," he said.
"I have looked at results in multimedia, and they do not allow me to say that we are about to invest such sums in it," he said.
